params.prompt: Vertical 9:16 product film. A tall portrait smart mirror with a slim brushed-metal bezel on a round metal pedestal stands centre frame in a dark seamless studio. Three overhead spotlights snap on one after another, then a ring of warm vanity bulbs around the mirror lights up one by one. The camera slowly orbits and pushes in; a soft highlight sweeps across the clean glass; a pool of light and a faint reflection on the glossy floor; drifting dust in the beams. Leave clear empty space above the mirror. No people, no text. Premium, minimal, photoreal.
